SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: AcquisitionSession record (trust-kernel): {session_id: UUID reserved before browser boots, target_url, profile_id?, transitions: STARTED->LIVE->RELEASED|FAILED with timestamps, action_traces: [{ts, action, target_accessible_name?, url_before, url_after, result|error}], artifacts: [{kind: screenshot|replay|dom_snapshot, digest}], bytes_digest: sha256 binding the run to the canonical evidence bytes, failure_class?: closed-taxonomy enum (absence-of-evidence is a class, never silent), redaction_applied: bool}. Gives FYD/PING a typed answer to 'under what observed execution did these website bytes arrive', driver-agnostic over Crawl4AI or any browser driver.
